sql: SELECT caller, file, line FROM calls WHERE callee LIKE '%clamp_to_aspect_bounds%' ORDER BY file, line;
SELECT caller, file, line FROM calls WHERE callee LIKE '%stage_halves%' OR callee LIKE '%stage_observed%' OR callee LIKE '%stage_ids%' ORDER BY file, line;
SELECT callee, file, line FROM refs WHERE callee LIKE '%use-findings-window%' ORDER BY file, line;
SELECT symbol, file, def_line FROM symbol WHERE symbol LIKE '%openReport%' OR symbol LIKE '%openFindings%' ORDER BY file;
